mapper.select: /*selectCommonMpIvOrderDetailPopInfo*/ SELECT H.PO_NO -- [00] , DECODE(H.DOC_TYPE,'S','선입고','F','(긴급발주)','') AS DOC_TEXT -- [01] , H.PO_CREATE_DATE -- [02] , (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = H.ADD_USER_ID) AS USER_NAME -- [03] , DECODE(CMP.AGENT_OPEN_FLAG,'N','코리아이플랫폼(주)',(SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = H.AGENT)) AS AGNET_TEXT -- [04] , (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = H.BUYER AND TYPE = 'C001' AND CODE = H.CHANGE_USER_DEPT) AS USER_DEPT -- [05] , H.DELY_TO_LOCATION -- [06] , ( CASE WHEN H.BUYER = 'KRDAEH0123' THEN '' WHEN H.BUYER = 'KRDAEH0133' THEN '' WHEN H.BUYER = 'KRDAEH0134' THEN '' ELSE H.PO_REMARK END) AS PO_REMARK -- [07] , H.DOC_TYPE -- [08] , H.CHANGE_USER_ID -- [09] , H.AGENT -- [10] , H.CHANGE_USER_DEPT , H.SELLER , ( CASE WHEN ( LENGTH(C.EXP_ADD_USER_ID) != 0 AND C.EXP_TR = 'Y') --두가지 조건을 모두 쓰는 경우 THEN CASE WHEN (C.EXP_ADD_USER_ID != H.ADD_USER_ID AND H.PROCESS_TYPE !='2') THEN C.RPT_URL ELSE '' END WHEN ( LENGTH(C.EXP_ADD_USER_ID) != 0 ) --ADD_USER_ID제외만 있는경우 THEN CASE WHEN (C.EXP_ADD_USER_ID != H.ADD_USER_ID) THEN C.RPT_URL ELSE '' END WHEN ( C.EXP_TR = 'Y') --TR거래 제외만 있는 경우 THEN CASE WHEN (H.PROCESS_TYPE !='2') THEN C.RPT_URL ELSE '' END ELSE C.RPT_URL --아무 조건이 없으면 END) AS RPT_URL -- 특수로직 해당사항이 없으면 url 결과가 없으므로 default url을 사용 -- [11] FROM ICOMPOHD H, ICOMCMPY CMP , ( SELECT X.SLG_NAME , Y.COM_CODE BUYER , Y.COL01_DATA RPT_URL , NVL(Y.COL02_DATA, 'N') AS EXP_TR --Y이면 TR거래 아닌 조건 , NVL(Y.COL03_DATA, '') AS EXP_ADD_USER_ID --제외 USER_ID FROM BNTSLGDEF X, BNTSLGIMP Y WHERE X.SLG_ID = Y.SLG_ID AND X.SLG_ID = 'P06-0000025' AND Y.COM_CODE = #{buyer} --param buyer com_code AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN X.OPEN_DATE AND X.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN Y.OPEN_DATE AND Y.CLOSE_DATE ) C WHERE H.BUYER = #{buyer} AND H.PO_NO = #{po_no} AND H.STATUS <> 'D' AND H.BUYER = CMP.COM_CODE AND H.BUYER = C.BUYER(+)

/*selectCommonMpIvOrderDetailPopList*/ SELECT D.BUYER_ITEM_NO -- [00] , D.DESCRIPTION -- [01] , D.SPECIFICATION -- [02] , D.ITEM_QTY -- [03] , D.UNIT_MEASURE -- [04] , D.UNIT_PRICE -- [05] , TRUNC(NVL(D.ITEM_QTY,0) * NVL(D.UNIT_PRICE,0)) AS PO_AMT -- [06] , D.RD_DATE -- [07] , D.REF_PR_NO -- [08] , D.PO_SEQ -- [09] , D.BYIT_COMORG_CODE -- [10] , D.CONTRACT_NO -- [11] , D.CONTRACT_SEQ -- [12] , D.PO_REMARK FROM ICOMPODT D WHERE D.BUYER = #{buyer} AND D.PO_NO = #{po_no} AND D.STATUS <> 'D' ORDER BY D.PO_SEQ

/*getCommonMpIvBuyerOrderDetailListPop_v2*/ SELECT D.BUYER_ITEM_NO -- [00] , D.DESCRIPTION -- [01] , D.SPECIFICATION -- [02] , D.ITEM_QTY -- [03] , D.UNIT_MEASURE -- [04] , D.UNIT_PRICE -- [05] , TRUNC(NVL(D.ITEM_QTY,0) * NVL(D.UNIT_PRICE,0)) AS PO_AMT -- [06] , D.RD_DATE -- [07] , D.REF_PR_NO -- [08] , D.PO_SEQ -- [09] , D.BYIT_COMORG_CODE -- [10] , D.CONTRACT_NO -- [11] , D.CONTRACT_SEQ -- [12] , D.PO_REMARK , D.IMAGE_KEY , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMATCH WHERE DOC_NO = D.IMAGE_KEY) AS IMAGE_KEY_CNT ,DECODE((SELECT AGENT_OPEN_FLAG FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = D.BUYER), 'N', 'KRKORE0001', (SELECT B.AGENT FROM ICOMPOHD B WHERE D.BUYER = B.BUYER AND D.PO_NO = B.PO_NO)) AS AGENT_CODE ,(SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = D.BUYER AND TYPE = 'Z014' AND CODE = D.ACCOUNT_TYPE) AS ACCOUNT_NAME -- 계정명 ,(select DECODE(COUNT(*),0 , '', 1 , DECODE(D.BUDGET_DEPT ,MAX(F.CODE1), MAX((SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 T WHERE T.COMPANY_CODE = D.BUYER AND T.TYPE = 'C001' AND T.CODE = F.CODE1)) ,''), MAX((SELECT MAX((SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 T WHERE T.COMPANY_CODE = D.BUYER AND T.TYPE = 'C001' AND T.CODE = F.CODE1)) FROM ICOMCOD3 E , ICOMCOD3 F WHERE E.BUYER = D.BUYER AND E.CODE1 = D.BUDGET_DEPT AND E.TYPE = 'DTOD' AND E.BUYER = F.BUYER AND E.CODE2 = F.CODE1 AND F.TYPE = 'DTOA' AND F.CODE1 = D.BUDGET_DEPT AND DECODE(F.FLAG,'Y',DECODE( D.BUDGET_DEPT ,F.CODE1,'N','Y'),'N') = 'N' AND F.CODE2 = D.ACCOUNT_TYPE)) ) FROM ICOMCOD3 E , ICOMCOD3 F WHERE E.BUYER = D.BUYER AND E.CODE1 = D.BUDGET_DEPT AND E.TYPE = 'DTOD' AND E.BUYER = F.BUYER AND E.CODE2 = F.CODE1 AND F.TYPE = 'DTOA' AND F.CODE2 = D.ACCOUNT_TYPE ) BUDGET_DEPT_NAME, -- 예산부서 (SELECT F_GET_PR_STTS(D.BUYER, D.PR_NO, D.PR_SEQ , 1) FROM DUAL) AS PR_STATUS_TEXT FROM ICOMPODT D WHERE D.BUYER = #{buyer} AND D.PO_NO = #{po_no} AND D.STATUS <> 'D' ORDER BY D.PO_SEQ
